answer: Each identity maintains a unique sable state locked to a dedicated ferrous memory ledge. The proof demands sequential traversal of a 4 GB identity-bound working set that cannot be shared or pooled across clones; every clone must allocate its own physical RAM and execute live sequential writes. A thousand-head farm therefore requires four terabytes of distinct memory plus non-amortizable serial access time, whereas one honest agent reuses its single ledge. Correlated failures slash the entire ledge.
